main_text.p: veris, quod ita fcribitur brevi evane-scit, nec characteris vestigium aliquod relinquitur: Veruntamen si infusio galarum chartæ illinatur, protinus literæ velut atramento scripte legenti proflant, quas tamen penna spiritu vitrioli intincta, uno illitu, prorsus delet; atque statim alia liquori Tartari imbuta denuo reddit. Tinctura violarum cærulea, oleo vitrioli suffusa, purpura fcit: cui si guttas quasdam spiritus Cornu Cervi addas, color iste purpureus in viridem mutatur. Lignum Acanthium Brasilia petitum, aquæ communi infusum, tincturam grate rubicundam, vino rubello fimilem deponit; huic si parum acieti destillati infundas, liquor instar vini albi limpidus apparet: guttæ quædam olei Tartari, colorem valde purpureum reducunt; dein si spiritus vitrioli infundatur, instar vini Hispanici pallide flavescit. Hoc ritu imitari licet famosum illum Ἀφροδίτης, qui aquâ fontanâ copiose ingestâ evomere solebat in vitra crystal-

page.notes: Several words are doubtful in the scan, notably "Ἀφροδίτης" (Greek, uncertain) and "instar"; the stained lower right corner and the final word "crystal-" continuing on the next page. The left edge shows show-through and is not transcribed.
